citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The licensee does not have a written program of veterinary care available for review for the cats. The written program of
veterinary care ensures that the facility has a program to follow, and the animals receive adequate veterinary care. The
licensee must establish a formal arrangement with their attending veterinarian for the cats including a written program of
veterinary care and regularly scheduled visits to the premises.
Correct by 09/29/2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
